name: Subcontractor Risk Compliance Tracker – Single Pass
rationale: Entry-level credit pack for solo practitioners or occasional audit checks. Lowers adoption friction with a sub-€20 psychological threshold, allowing law firms and notary offices to trial the platform with minimal commitment. Covers approximately 10 subcontractor compliance scans or deadline-monitoring runs.

name: Subcontractor Risk Compliance Tracker – Standard Pass
rationale: Core volume pack targeting small-to-mid-size legal studios managing multiple subcontracting relationships simultaneously. The €49 price point sits at a classic B2B impulse-buy threshold and delivers a per-credit cost of ~€1.63 vs €1.90 in the Single Pass, creating a visible value step-up. Covers approximately 30 compliance audit runs or mixed monitoring tasks.

name: Subcontractor Risk Compliance Tracker – Power Pass
rationale: High-volume pack for structured law firms, notary networks, or compliance departments handling large portfolios of subcontracting chains. At €99, the per-credit cost drops to ~€1.32, creating a strong economic incentive to anchor at this tier. The anchoring effect also makes the Standard Pass appear as a reasonable mid-ground, boosting blended ASP across the board.
